php gives a filter one final `filter(..., $closing = true)` with an EMPTY
brigade — no buckets at all. elephc built a bucket whatever the input length, so
`while ($b = stream_bucket_make_writeable($in))` ran a second time over an empty
`$b->data`, and the filter applied twice: `$b->data = "<" . $b->data . ">"` over
"abc" answered "<<abc>>" where php answers "<abc>".
